items.t: Do you accept my insurance?
items.z: 你们接受我的保险吗？

items.t: What's my copay for this visit?
items.z: 这次就诊我要付多少自付额？

items.t: I haven't met my deductible yet.
items.z: 我还没达到免赔额。

items.t: Is this doctor in-network?
items.z: 这位医生在保险网络内吗？

items.t: I got a bill for something I thought was covered.
items.z: 我收到一张账单，我以为那是保险覆盖的。

items.t: Can you send an itemized bill?
items.z: 能寄一份明细账单吗？

items.t: I need a referral to see a specialist.
items.z: 看专科医生我需要转诊。

items.t: Can I set up a payment plan?
items.z: 可以分期付款吗？

items.t: My prescription needs prior authorization.
items.z: 我的处方需要预先授权。

items.t: Is there a generic version of this medication?
items.z: 这个药有仿制药版本吗？

items.t: Open enrollment ends next week.
items.z: 保险开放注册期下周结束。

items.t: I'd like to add my spouse to my plan.
items.z: 我想把配偶加进我的保险计划。

items.t: What does the premium come out to per month?
items.z: 保费每个月是多少？

items.t: I'm calling to file a claim.
items.z: 我打电话来申请理赔。

items.t: Someone rear-ended me. Whose insurance covers it?
items.z: 有人追尾了我，谁的保险来赔？

items.t: Can I get a quote for renters insurance?
items.z: 能给我一份租客保险的报价吗？

items.t: My rate went up for no reason.
items.z: 我的保费莫名其妙涨了。

items.t: Is dental covered under this plan?
items.z: 这个计划包含牙科吗？

items.t: I'd like to appeal the denial.
items.z: 我想对拒赔提出申诉。

items.t: Can you explain what this code on the bill means?
items.z: 能解释一下账单上这个代码是什么意思吗？
